# Keep image layers small; always clean the package cache.
# Ok lines come first: the clean-all exclusion spans forward otherwise.
# ok: missing-yum-clean-all
RUN yum install -y httpd && yum clean all
# ok: missing-yum-clean-all
RUN yum install -y httpd && \
    yum clean all
# ruleid: missing-yum-clean-all
RUN yum install -y httpd
# ruleid: missing-yum-clean-all
RUN yum update
